title: FORK: Co-Evolving Safe Disclosure and Decision Skills Against Attackers Who Read Every Refusal
abstract: arXiv:2611.33879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a guardrail rejects an LLM agent's action, its message reaches any attacker observing the trajectory: a fixed refusal leaves benign users unable to recover, whereas an explanation can tell the attacker what to try next. We study this as safe disclosure: explaining rejections so that authorized tasks recover without increasing adaptive attack success. Safe disclosure depends on both the decision and the message: what the guardrail blocks and what it reveals to the agent and the attacker. Because hand-written rules alone cannot anticipate how adaptive attackers probe decisions or use messages, we introduce FORK, which co-evolves a guardrail's natural-language decision and disclosure skills with an attacker that reads every public message. Each exploited message and permissive decision gives FORK evidence for a gradient-free revision of its natural-language skill library. We evaluate FORK on four benchmarks. Averaged over three agents

translated_title: FORK：针对会读取每条拒绝消息的攻击者，共同演化安全披露与决策技能
translated_abstract: 当防护机制拒绝LLM智能体的某个动作时，其消息会传达到任何观察该轨迹的攻击者：一成不变的拒绝会让良性用户无法恢复任务，而解释性信息则可能告诉攻击者下一步该尝试什么。我们将这一问题界定为“安全披露”：通过解释拒绝原因，使授权任务得以恢复，同时不提高自适应攻击的成功率。安全披露同时取决于决策和消息两个方面：防护机制拦截了什么，以及它向智能体和攻击者透露了什么。由于仅靠手写规则无法预判自适应攻击者如何探测决策或利用消息，我们提出了FORK，它使防护机制的自然语言决策与披露技能，与一个会读取每条公开消息的攻击者共同演化。每条被利用的消息和每个过于宽松的决策，都为FORK提供了对其自然语言技能库进行无梯度修订的证据。我们在四个基准上评估了FORK。在三个智能体上的平均结果表明……
tldr: FORK框架通过让防护机制与一个读取所有公开消息的攻击者共同演化其自然语言决策与披露技能，实现了既能帮助授权任务从拒绝中恢复、又不增加自适应攻击成功率的安全披露。
en_tdlr: FORK co-evolves a guardrail's natural-language decision and disclosure skills with an attacker that reads every public message, enabling safe disclosure that helps authorized tasks recover without increasing adaptive attack success.
